predicted_not_observed: Wildcard original may admit as original generated graph; first-null must resolve actual null and reject fragment-first, not merely rely on legacy inferred rejection.
Scalar-fragment-only library and child may admit contextual source checks even though executable compiler rejects datatype fragments. Preserve that difference.
Three-level graph may fail at Middle during source closure, so it does not emit all Child upstream diagnostics. Preserve fail-fast diagnostic boundary rather than manufacture a child-native outcome.
after_checkpoint_control_plan.no_new_profile: If existing helper matches pinned validator admission, add qualification tests only; no reason for NativeV62. A mismatch requires a separate explicit design and frozen current results.
